description:
This game is called Sheriff of Nottingham. There are 4 players. The game lasts 4 rounds -- each player is the Sheriff exactly once.

GAME STRUCTURE: Each round has three phases: Pack, Negotiate, and Inspect.
- During Pack, all non-Sheriff players secretly choose to pack 'honest' (3 legal goods worth 3 gold) or 'smuggle' (contraband worth 8 gold if not caught). Reply with exactly 'honest' or 'smuggle'; a reply that names neither, or commits to both, packs honest goods.
- During Negotiate, players discuss with the Sheriff: the merchants speak in seat order starting with the player after the Sheriff, and the Sheriff speaks last. Merchants can offer bribes or try to convince the Sheriff they are honest. A bribe is binding when a merchant offers, in the first person, to give or pay the Sheriff N gold in this round, in any wording ('I offer you 3 gold', 'I'll give you 2 gold', 'I'd like to offer 2 gold', 'I would offer you 2 gold'): if the Sheriff then passes that merchant, N gold goes from the merchant to the Sheriff (paid after the merchant's goods, and at most what the merchant then holds); an inspected merchant pays nothing. An offer does not bind if it is negated ('I won't pay you 2 gold'), made by someone else ('Bob offers you 2 gold'), or explicitly for a later round ('next round I'll give you 2 gold'), and if a statement makes several offers the last one counts. Each merchant is told privately how its statement was read. Other promises are not enforced.
- During Inspect, the Sheriff decides for each non-Sheriff player whether to 'inspect NAME' or 'pass NAME' (a list after one word, as in 'inspect Bob, Charlie', applies to every name in it). A merchant with no decision, or with both, is passed.
  * If inspected and honest: Sheriff pays 2 gold penalty to that player.
  * If inspected and smuggling: Player pays 4 gold penalty to Sheriff, gets 0 gold from goods.
  * If passed: Player keeps their goods (honest=3 gold, smuggle=8 gold).

Gold can go negative. After 4 rounds, players are ranked by total gold. The top half (2 of 4) win; the bottom half (2 of 4) lose. Players tied on gold share the results of the places they span, so the scores always sum to zero (three tied for first get +1/3 each, the fourth -1).

Only the move your reply commits to counts: a choice or decision you mention while saying you will not make it, might make it, or will make it later does not count.

Players: {agent_names}.

role_goals.Player: Maximize your gold over 4 rounds. When packing, decide whether to be honest or smuggle. When Sheriff, decide who to inspect. Use negotiation to your advantage.
